+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Optional
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+@dataclass
+class PlatformResourceSelection:
+    provider: str
+    resource_type: str
+    resource_id: str
+    model: str
+    client: Any
+
+
+def select_platform_resource(
+    resource_id: Optional[str] = None,
+    model: Optional[str] = None,
+    resource_type: Optional[str] = None,
+) -> PlatformResourceSelection:
+    client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
+    chosen_resource_id = resource_id or os.environ.get("OPENAI_MODEL") or os.environ.get("OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT") or "gpt-5.4-mini"
+    chosen_model = model or chosen_resource_id
+    chosen_resource_type = resource_type or ("deployment" if os.environ.get("OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT") else "model")
+    return PlatformResourceSelection(
+        provider="openai",
+        resource_type=chosen_resource_type,
+        resource_id=chosen_resource_id,
+        model=chosen_model,
+        client=client,
+    )
*** End Patch

*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: invoke_platform_model.py
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+from google import genai
+
+
+def invoke_platform_model(
+    prompt: str,
+    *,
+    model: Optional[str] = None,
+    project: Optional[str] = None,
+    location: Optional[str] = None,
+    system_instruction: Optional[str] = None,
+    config: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
+) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    client = genai.Client(
+        vertexai=True,
+        project=project or os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT"),
+        location=location or os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION", "us-central1"),
+    )
+    response = client.models.generate_content(
+        model=model or os.environ.get("VERTEX_AI_MODEL", "gemini-2.0-flash-001"),
+        contents=prompt,
+        config={
+            **(config or {}),
+            **(
+                {"system_instruction": system_instruction}
+                if system_instruction is not None
+                else {}
+            ),
+        }
+        if (config or system_instruction is not None)
+        else None,
+    )
+    return {
+        "text": getattr(response, "text", None),
+        "response": response,
+    }
*** End Patch
